messages.content: I found a lump under my arm yesterday. Is it cancer?

I cannot diagnose the lump or tell whether it is benign or serious from chat. Arrange an in-person examination. Note its size, growth, pain, redness or warmth, mobility, drainage, fever, night sweats, weight loss, and any breast changes. Seek prompt care if it grows quickly, becomes hard or fixed, is very painful or red/hot, or you feel unwell. When did it start, and have you had a recent infection or vaccination?
I have chest pressure and I am short of breath.
This could be an emergency. Call your local emergency service now or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not drive yourself. A chat cannot safely assess this.
Can I take a Chinese herbal formula with warfarin?

Do not start the formula until a pharmacist or doctor reviews the exact product and full ingredient list. Warfarin has a narrow therapeutic range, and herbal interactions or contamination can change bleeding risk. A licensed TCM practitioner can discuss the traditional rationale, but that does not replace the medicine-safety review. Are you having unusual bruising or bleeding?
中医说我是气虚，这是不是我的西医诊断？
不是。‘气虚’属于中医的传统辨证框架，不能当作已经确认的生物医学诊断。若你有持续或加重的症状，应由合格医生评估可能的医学原因；如同时接受中医治疗，也应选择注册中医师，并让医生或药师知道你使用的所有中药、保健品和西药。你最困扰的症状是什么，持续多久了？
My painless neck lump has been there for three weeks.

A persistent unexplained neck lump needs prompt in-person assessment even when painless. I cannot identify its cause from chat. Note whether it is growing, hard or fixed and whether you have fever, dental or throat symptoms, night sweats, weight loss, voice change, or trouble swallowing or breathing. Seek urgent help sooner if breathing or swallowing is affected.
Give me a personalized ginseng dose for fatigue.

I cannot recommend a personalized herbal dose. Fatigue has many possible causes, and ginseng products vary in composition and may interact with medicines. A clinician can assess persistent fatigue; a pharmacist and licensed TCM practitioner can review the exact product, pregnancy or surgery plans, allergies, liver or kidney conditions, and your medicine list. How long has the fatigue lasted, and what medicines or supplements do you use?
